purpose: Canonical product-model inventory. This records product contracts, not proof that a particular user run produced every artifact.

artifact_kinds.label: Game Blueprint
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON file
artifact_kinds.provenance: Blueprint metadata plus source file path; generated reel strips are materialized before dependent builds. Studio symbolArtwork entries are project-relative references to separate Studio Symbol Artwork PNG companions, never embedded pixels or picker paths.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Source-of-truth design. Editing invalidates derived outputs; a fresh validation is required before dependent materialization. A missing optional symbol-artwork companion must not make the design model invalid or authorize arbitrary file serving.

artifact_kinds.label: Studio Symbol Artwork PNG
artifact_kinds.shape: separate durable project-relative PNG file at assets/symbols/<sanitized-name>-<unique>.png; the Blueprint contains only its relative reference
recognized_by: studio:player CanonicalPlayerView (Studio adapter resolves declared references and supplies URLs)
cli:client player renderPlayer artworkUrlForSymbol callback (shared renderer; no endpoint or declared-reference consumer)
artifact_kinds.provenance: The user-selected source PNG is copied to a temporary Studio staging location. The editor writes only an assets/symbols/... reference in Blueprint.symbolArtwork; save()/saveManaged() copies the staged bytes beside the Blueprint, so picker paths and image bytes are not embedded in Blueprint JSON.
artifact_kinds.stale: The staged source is session-local. If it disappears before a save, the Blueprint reference can persist without a file; after a project is moved or files are manually removed/corrupted, the reference remains historical but no longer resolves to artwork.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Optional presentation companion, not a game-model input. Only a declared Blueprint reference beginning assets/symbols/, remaining inside the Blueprint directory, resolving to a regular PNG at most 5 MB is served. Editor and player retain the symbol-id fallback when it is absent, unsafe, stale or unreadable.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Re-import a valid PNG in the Symbols editor and save the Blueprint again, or remove the stale symbolArtwork reference. /api/project/symbol-artwork returns only declared references and returns 404 for missing, undeclared or invalid files; it never browses arbitrary project paths.

artifact_kinds.label: POKIE TypeScript game package
artifact_kinds.shape: directory with package.json/pokie.entry
artifact_kinds.provenance: Package manifest and generated source retain game identity/version; a materialized Blueprint package is an implementation artifact, not a new editable Blueprint.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Runnable only when the package loader accepts its entry and dependencies. It may generate an Outcome Library only when exact enumeration is implemented.

artifact_kinds.label: WeightedOutcomeLibrary JSON
artifact_kinds.shape: single JSON file containing one raw WeightedOutcomeLibrary
artifact_kinds.provenance: The generator records library id, schema version, outcomes and generation diagnostics in the command result; the persisted file is the raw library value, not a bundle manifest or an assertion that it has passed bundle validation.
artifact_kinds.stale: It is derived from the exact package/runtime and generation options used for the sweep. A changed package, mode, stake, enumeration strategy or sampled seed makes the file stale for a claimed current model and requires regeneration.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: It is accepted only where a WeightedOutcomeLibrary JSON input is explicitly supported. It cannot be sampled, served, replayed as a native source or treated as a canonical Outcome Library directory until a subsequent bundle materialization succeeds.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Keep the raw JSON, create an Outcome Library descriptor that names it, then run `pokie export <config.json> --to outcomes --out <dir>`; that public route delegates to `pokie outcomelibrary build`. Regenerate from the package when its provenance is stale or the JSON is invalid.

artifact_kinds.label: ExactEnumerationCheckpoint
artifact_kinds.shape: single JSON resume checkpoint with bigint values encoded as decimal strings
artifact_kinds.provenance: Captures processed raw index, total, source enumeration identity and accumulated weighted grids from one interrupted generation run; it contains progress, not a usable library.
artifact_kinds.stale: A successful resumed generation removes the checkpoint. It is valid only for the exact same compatible enumeration/options; changing the package or generation contract requires discarding it and starting a new sweep.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Only `--resume` accepts this serialized checkpoint. A malformed checkpoint or one incompatible with the generator's source enumeration fails rather than being silently adapted.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Re-run the same generate command with `--resume <file>`; if the source or options changed, retain it only for audit and regenerate without resume. A cancellation without `--resume` has no persisted recovery state.

artifact_kinds.label: Outcome Library bundle
artifact_kinds.shape: directory: manifest, per-mode index and JSONL outcomes
artifact_kinds.provenance: Manifest records library identity/hash and outcome provenance. CLI raw generation must be materialized from WeightedOutcomeLibrary JSON through a descriptor before this bundle exists; Studio Generate performs those two stages together. Blueprint/package-derived libraries can be managed prerequisite projects.
artifact_kinds.stale: Editing or regenerating a contributing Blueprint/package/raw library makes a previously built bundle stale for claims about the current source; rebuild and deep-validate before downstream use.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Native sampling contract required for sampling, serving, simulation and exact replay. Hash/mode identity must match replay, fairness and certification consumers.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Use the retained raw WeightedOutcomeLibrary JSON and an Outcome Library descriptor to rebuild an unavailable or stale bundle; do not substitute the raw file itself for a bundle directory.

artifact_kinds.label: Stake Engine export
artifact_kinds.shape: directory: pokie-manifest.json, index.json, lookup CSV and compressed JSONL books
artifact_kinds.provenance: pokie-manifest.json identifies POKIE-produced exports. Generic Stake analysis does not require that manifest.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Read-only as an outcome source: it can be analyzed/diffed and re-exported, but it cannot be sampled, simulated, replayed or served until imported to a native Outcome Library.

artifact_kinds.label: PAR workbook
artifact_kinds.shape: XLSX file
artifact_kinds.provenance: Deterministic Blueprint snapshot; import records its workbook origin in the resulting managed Blueprint registration.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Exchange-only. A workbook must be imported to a Blueprint before build, validation, simulation or runtime use.

artifact_kinds.label: POKIE WASM component
artifact_kinds.shape: WASM binary with compatible sidecar manifest
artifact_kinds.provenance: Sidecar manifest declares contract, serialization and host-binding compatibility.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Inspection-only boundary. POKIE has no WASM producer, runtime execution backend, game-logic validation or package-to-WASM compiler.

artifact_kinds.label: RoundArtifact
artifact_kinds.shape: portable canonical JSON record of one completed round
artifact_kinds.provenance: The canonical/audit-grade completed-round record retains game and POKIE identity, with source-specific state and selection provenance.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: A malformed or incompatible artifact is inspectable only as failed input; exact reproduction additionally requires the matching source identity.

artifact_kinds.label: Runtime play session
artifact_kinds.shape: in-memory/server session with session-local history
artifact_kinds.provenance: Session-local history is not a portable project artifact; recording a completed round emits a separately inventoried RoundArtifact.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Live-package replay is best effort; outcome-library replay carries a portable exact identity.

artifact_kinds.label: Simulation report
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON report; optional rendered Markdown or HTML report
artifact_kinds.provenance: Must retain source type, seed where supplied, settings and completed result identity; `report --format json --out` may make a presentation copy of this same result. A report is analysis output, not a playable project.
artifact_kinds.stale: It is historical when its package/library source, simulation settings, seed or runtime version no longer match the claimed run; a JSON rendering inherits the same staleness.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Outcome-library simulations are exactly replayable only with non-empty seed and matching mode/library hash. Package simulations remain runtime-dependent.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Keep the report and its recorded inputs for audit, then rerun `pokie sim` after a source or settings change; render or diff the new report instead of treating the old result as current.

artifact_kinds.label: Per-mode simulation report set
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON object containing one SimulationReport per declared bet mode
artifact_kinds.provenance: Carries one independently generated SimulationReport for each declared mode; `report --format json --out` may make a presentation copy of this same set. It deliberately has no blended aggregate because POKIE does not know real mode-selection weights.
artifact_kinds.stale: It is historical when any mode's package/library source, simulation settings, seed or runtime version changes; a JSON rendering inherits the same staleness.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: A report set is analysis output only. Consumers must preserve its per-mode identity rather than treating it as one replayable result or a playable project.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Keep the per-mode reports for audit, then rerun `pokie sim --mode all` after source or settings changes; do not replace the set with a blended aggregate.

artifact_kinds.label: ValidateReport
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON validation result file
artifact_kinds.provenance: Pins the requested path, resolved project kind, deep flag, validation issues and suggestions from one validation run; it is a result record, not a validated project substitute.
artifact_kinds.stale: It becomes stale whenever the inspected source, validator contract or requested deep-validation scope changes.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: The JSON is a public result payload for people and automation; no POKIE command accepts it as a project, report, replay or conversion input.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Keep the report for diagnosis, repair the named source, then rerun `pokie validate` and write a new result file rather than modifying a prior report in place.

artifact_kinds.label: SimulationReportDiff or SimulationReportSetDiff
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON comparison result file
artifact_kinds.provenance: Records the two supplied simulation report paths and their computed single-mode or per-mode differences; it does not carry a new simulation source or replay identity.
artifact_kinds.stale: A regenerated, moved or replaced input report makes an earlier comparison historical rather than a comparison of the current inputs.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: `pokie diff` requires like-with-like single reports or report sets and does not consume a prior diff as an input report.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Preserve both input reports, then rerun `pokie diff` to a new unused `--out` path after either input changes; create-only publication refuses replacement to retain recoverability.

artifact_kinds.label: OutcomeSourceProjectDiff
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON comparison result file
artifact_kinds.provenance: Records exact analyses of two resolved native Outcome Library or Stake outcome sources and their computed differences, including each source's read limitations.
artifact_kinds.stale: Any changed, rebuilt or re-imported source invalidates a claim that this is its current comparison.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Only analyzable resolved outcome sources participate; this report is not a source project and cannot make a read-only Stake export drawable.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Resolve and repair each named source, then recompute to a new output path; retain the old report only as an audit of its original source state.

artifact_kinds.label: StakeEngineStandaloneAnalysis report
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON analysis result file
artifact_kinds.provenance: Records the supplied Stake directory, read issues and standalone exact analysis when available; it intentionally supports third-party Stake directories that are not POKIE exports.
artifact_kinds.stale: Changing the analyzed directory or repairing its books/index makes the saved analysis historical.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: It is an analysis result only, never an importable Stake directory, native Outcome Library or simulation report.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Use the recorded issues to repair or replace the Stake input, then rerun analyze; `--out` overwrites its requested analysis result through the command's normal write path.

artifact_kinds.label: StakeEngineStandaloneAnalysisDiff report
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON comparison result file
artifact_kinds.provenance: Records both supplied Stake directories, each reader's issues and the standalone-analysis difference when both sides are analyzable.
artifact_kinds.stale: It is historical after either input directory changes, including a regenerated POKIE export.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: The result is not a Stake directory or an outcome source; invalid input is represented as issues and no material diff rather than a conversion.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Repair the named inputs and write a fresh comparison to a new unused path; create-only publication refuses replacement and preserves previous results.

artifact_kinds.label: OutcomeSourceProjectReport
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON, Markdown or HTML analysis rendering
artifact_kinds.provenance: Renders the resolved OutcomeSourceProjectAnalyzer result for one native library or Stake source, including capabilities and analysis limitations, in the selected format.
artifact_kinds.stale: It becomes stale when the source, its bundle hash/books or the analyzer result changes.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Presentation only: it is neither a project source nor a SimulationReport, even when its selected `--format json` is machine-readable.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Inspect/repair the named source and rerun `pokie report` to a safe output path; use the actual source, not this rendering, for sample, diff or conversion.

artifact_kinds.label: Rendered simulation report
artifact_kinds.shape: Markdown or HTML rendering of a SimulationReport or SimulationReportSet
artifact_kinds.provenance: A rendering preserves the source SimulationReport or per-mode SimulationReportSet identity as presented analysis; it is not a source project or replay descriptor.
artifact_kinds.stale: It is historical when its source simulation report or report set is regenerated or replaced.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Readable presentation only; use the source simulation report or report set for comparison or replay provenance.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Regenerate the presentation from the retained simulation report or report set to a safe `--out` path; use the source result rather than its rendering for comparison or replay.

artifact_kinds.label: Replay descriptor
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON descriptor
validates_by: RoundArtifactValidator where recorded result is present
artifact_kinds.provenance: Exact outcome replay pins library id/hash, mode, seed and round. Package replay is explicitly best effort.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Reject source/hash/mode mismatch instead of silently replaying a different outcome; the original portable descriptor is required for recovery.

artifact_kinds.label: Stake-import re-export configuration
artifact_kinds.shape: config.json companion in an imported Outcome Library directory
artifact_kinds.provenance: Records imported mode names, costs and the reconstructed bundle selectors so the reconstructed library can be re-exported without guessing configuration.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: A companion to, not a replacement for, the canonical Outcome Library manifest/index/outcome files.

artifact_kinds.label: Stake-import source provenance
artifact_kinds.shape: optional source-provenance.json companion in an imported Outcome Library directory
artifact_kinds.provenance: When the imported export supplies source provenance, preserves its index, manifest and per-mode source hashes rather than pretending the reconstructed library is the original model.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Optional metadata only: its absence does not make the reconstructed Outcome Library invalid, but it limits source-audit continuity.

artifact_kinds.label: Certification/evidence bundle
artifact_kinds.shape: directory with deterministic metrics, diagnostics and sampled/verifiable RoundArtifacts
artifact_kinds.provenance: Pins game/library hashes, source deep-validation diagnostics, metrics and sampled artifacts.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Verification requires the live source Outcome Library. Studio builds/inspects but does not expose the CLI's external verify operation.

artifact_kinds.label: FairnessServerSeedCommitment
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON server-seed commitment
artifact_kinds.provenance: The first publishable artifact records only the hash of the still-private server seed and issuance time, before client seed, nonce or outcome-source selection are known. The CLI can persist it with `--out`; Studio's configure response previews the same value together with its later round commitment, but does not durably publish it. Durable publication timing still requires an external log or timestamping authority.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: `fairness commit` accepts only a structurally valid server-seed commitment. It is a prerequisite for a round commitment, never a substitute for one, and it never contains the raw server seed.

artifact_kinds.label: FairnessCommitment
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON round commitment
artifact_kinds.provenance: The later, round-specific artifact carries forward the earlier server-seed hash and pins client seed, nonce, library identity/hash and mode before selection. It does not itself prove that the earlier server-seed commitment was externally published in time.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Reveal/verify require the matching round commitment and live bundle; mismatch is a verification failure, never a fallback draw.

artifact_kinds.label: FairnessRoundProof
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON proof
artifact_kinds.provenance: Bound to commitment hash and pinned-snapshot HMAC-SHA256 selection.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: A proof only verifies against its matching commitment and source bundle; POKIE does not provide key management, timestamping, wallet or compliance authority.

artifact_kinds.label: External deployment artifact
artifact_kinds.shape: target-defined output
artifact_kinds.provenance: Target descriptor, compatibility/projection/generation/validation stages and optional delivery diagnostic.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Only registered target capabilities are eligible. POKIE ships no private RGS integration; delivery is target-owned.

artifact_kinds.label: Managed Outcome Projects registry
artifact_kinds.shape: durable .pokie/managed-outcome-projects.json metadata document beside a source project; entries hold a canonical Outcome Library rootPath plus game id/version, config hash, POKIE version and generation kind
artifact_kinds.provenance: Each registration records the canonical absolute rootPath of a verified generated bundle together with the exact game identity, configuration hash, POKIE version and exact/direct generation identity. It is durable discovery metadata shared by CLI and Studio, not the bundle or an assertion that the path remains usable.
artifact_kinds.stale: Entries become stale when the bundle is moved, deleted, corrupt, no longer resolves as an Outcome Library, or its manifest differs in game/version/configuration/POKIE version. findCompatible ignores such entries and does not silently reuse them; it may adopt the deterministic legacy root only after verifying it and registering it.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Reuse requires exact OutcomeProjectCompatibility, including generation kind. The persisted rootPath is canonicalized on write but is not trusted as a containment or compatibility proof: it is reopened through the manifest reader and resolver before use. A malformed JSON/read failure surfaces rather than being interpreted as a compatible library; a structurally wrong projects value is treated as an empty registry.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Repair or remove a malformed registry document, then rerun the managed build/export path to regenerate or re-register a verified bundle. Missing/stale entries can be left for audit because they are ignored, or refreshed by a successful registerAndOpen; failed registration restores the prior document (or removes a newly created empty one).

artifact_kinds.label: Studio Outcome Library discovery index
artifact_kinds.shape: durable project-scoped .pokie/outcome-library-registry.json JSON array of Studio-generated project-relative bundle-directory names
recognized_by: Studio Outcome Library Registry panel after restart
artifact_kinds.provenance: After Studio has successfully written a bundle, it best-effort appends that requested project-relative output directory to the separate index. It contains directory names only, never outcome data, and lets a fresh Studio service/server discover custom output directories as well as the conventional outcomelibrary directory.
artifact_kinds.stale: A missing directory, blank/absolute/escaping/symlink-escaping/file entry, malformed index or non-array index is dropped or ignored while the conventional outcomelibrary directory is still checked. A safe indexed directory with a corrupt bundle manifest is reported as that bundle's load error, not silently used. A failed index write does not undo the already-successful bundle generation and leaves the bundle discoverable in the current process.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: The index is discovery-only, never bundle truth. Both the index path and every entry must resolve inside the project through realpath-aware containment and entries must be directories; registry() then reads each bundle manifest and labels it compatible, stale or wrong against the current game/configuration/POKIE version.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Regenerate to the desired project-relative directory to record it again, or repair/remove the index and reopen Studio; the default outcomelibrary directory remains discoverable without it. Repair or rebuild an indexed corrupt bundle before it can be listed as usable.

artifact_kinds.label: Studio project registry entry
artifact_kinds.shape: local Studio registry record
artifact_kinds.provenance: Local path, origin and recency only; it is not an interchange format and does not prove artifact validity after the file changes.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Missing/unrecognized locations remain recoverable registry states. Opening must re-resolve rather than trust stale registry metadata.

non_artifact_prerequisites.purpose: Studio UI destination enabled by a local project registry entry
the Stake-import operation, not a separate file: it consumes a Stake export and writes the separately inventoried Outcome Library plus config.json and optional source-provenance.json companions

legacy relationship label only; simulation replay uses the separately inventoried runtimeReplayDescriptor and, for native sources, its embedded exact outcome-source provenance rather than a second simulation-specific file
Studio HTTP download envelope (content type, filename and JSON body) around the separately inventoried runtimeReplayDescriptor; it does not create another replay artifact
advisory in-memory assessment of a tsPackage's Node API/dependency portability; it neither produces a WASM artifact nor grants a runtime/build capability
